about: Parsing fixtures. Each case states the nodes, the links and the diagnostics a mermaid
block must produce. `edges` are written as `from kind head to label`, one string per link,
sorted the way graphToJSON sorts them.
The cases that matter most are the ones at the bottom, where the parser meets syntax it
does not support. A dropped link makes the reference graph wrong and the learner is then
marked down for the tool's gap, so every one of those has to raise an error diagnostic

cases.name: graph TD with the four common node shapes
cases.source:
graph TD
  A[Rect] --> B(Round)
  B --> C{Diamond}
  C --> D((Circle))

cases.name: flowchart LR with the less common shapes
cases.source:
flowchart LR
  A([Stadium]) --> B[[Subroutine]]
  B --> C[(Cylinder)]
  C --> D{{Hexagon}}
  D --> E[/Parallelogram/]
  E --> F>Flag]
  F --> G(((Double)))

cases.name: every link kind and head
cases.source:
graph TD
  A --> B
  A --- C
  A -.-> D
  A ==> E
  A --o F
  A --x G
  A -.- H
  A === I
  A ----> J

cases.name: labels in both the pipe form and the mid link form
cases.source:
graph TD
  A -->|yes| B
  A -- no --> C
  A -.->|maybe| D
  A -. perhaps .-> E
  A ==>|surely| F
  A == certainly ==> G
  A -- open link --- H

edges: A solid open H open link

cases.name: a mid link label containing a hyphen
quoted captions containing the delimiter characters

edges: B solid arrow C a | pipe

cases.name: subgraphs, including a nested one and the bracketed title form
cases.source:
flowchart TB
  subgraph outer [Outer box]
    A --> B
    subgraph inner
      C --> D
    end
    B --> C
  end
  D --> E

cases.name: chains, ampersand groups, semicolons and comments
presentation directives are reported and ignored, never dropped in silence
cases.source:
graph TD
  A --> B
  style A fill:#f9f,stroke:#333
  classDef warn fill:#fee
  class B warn
  click A "https://example.com" _blank
  linkStyle 0 stroke-width:2px

cases.name: a bidirectional link becomes two directed links and says so
cases.source:
graph TD
  A <--> B
  C o--o D

cases.name: UNSUPPORTED: the new @{ } node metadata syntax is reported with its line
cases.source:
graph TD
  A --> B
  A@{ shape: rounded }
  B --> C

cases.name: UNSUPPORTED: an unclosed node caption is reported, not guessed at
UNSUPPORTED: a diagram that is not a flowchart is named
UNSUPPORTED: a subgraph left open is reported
cases.source:
graph TD
  subgraph one
    A --> B

cases.name: UNSUPPORTED: an unclosed link label is reported
